motion.name: sky-easing

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action pill button (View Projects, Send Message).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00a3ff; color: #00375a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; border: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost-style secondary action (Contact Me, Download Resume).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #00629d; border: 1px solid rgba(190, 199, 212, 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 32px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); background: #f2f4f6; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Base translucent card used across expertise, stats, and project surfaces.
components.html:
Full-Stack Architect

Scalable systems, precisely engineered.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(190,199,212,0.1); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0px 10px 20px rgba(0,98,157,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.5s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0px 20px 40px rgba(0,98,157,0.08), 0 0 20px rgba(0,163,255,.12); } .ds-glass-card-title { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: #191c1e; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-glass-card-desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 300; color: #3f4852; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact form field with focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #e6e8ea; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #191c1e; outline: none; transition: background 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-input:focus { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #00a3ff; }

components.name: Dock Nav Item
components.description: Floating desktop navigation dock icon button.
components.css: .ds-dock-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(0,98,157,0.08); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,98,157,0.06); color: #3f4852; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-dock-item:hover, .ds-dock-item:focus-visible { color: #00629d; background: rgba(207,229,255,0.5); border-color: rgba(0,98,157,0.2); }

narrative.overview:
This system treats the screen as an open sky rather than a boxed-in document: a fluid, expansive environment where code and craft coexist. It exists in two committed states — Sky Glass (light mode), a clean, oceanic-blue frosted-glass aesthetic, and Midnight Aurora (dark mode), an immersive violet aesthetic featuring an interactive WebGL ripple grid that reacts to the cursor. The same tonal-layering, glass, and shape language carries across both; only the hue family and interactive dark-mode background layer change.

Components read as airy and glass-forged: weightless, translucent, never heavy or industrial. Depth comes from stacked frosted sheets and hue-tinted ambient shadows, never from flat gray drop-shadows. The system breaks the "developer-portfolio template" look through intentional asymmetry — expansive whitespace, occasional overlapping glass containers, bento-style grids that vary column span rather than repeating identical tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Dual committed themes (Sky Glass / Midnight Aurora), not a single palette with an inverted dark variant.
No 1px solid divider lines anywhere; section and card boundaries are drawn with background tone shifts or a ghost border.
Every shadow and glow is hue-tinted (blue in light mode, violet in dark), never neutral gray or pure black.
Entrance motion is a first-class citizen: sections fade/slide up on scroll via a single shared easing curve.

rules.name: The No-Line Rule
rules.body: 1px solid dividers are prohibited for sectioning. Boundaries are drawn by shifting background color or, when a container would otherwise vanish into its background, by a Ghost Border: outline-variant at 10-20% opacity.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never neutral gray or pure black; they carry the mode's primary hue.

rules.name: The Contrast Bridge Rule
rules.body: Pair a bold headline in on-surface with an uppercase label-weight sub-header in primary directly above it. The size/weight jump carries the hierarchy before the copy is read.

rules.name: The Glass Rule
rules.body: True glass surfaces combine surface-container-lowest at ~70-80% opacity with backdrop-filter blur(10-24px). Reserve it for floating/overlapping elements, not full-bleed section backgrounds.

dos: Do use asymmetrical, unequal-column layouts (7/5, 8/4) over centered/symmetric grids.
Do tint every shadow and glow with the mode's primary hue; a gray shadow is a bug.
Do use the shared easing curve cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) for all entrance and hover motion.
Do reserve the purple/violet glow accent (168, 85, 247) for Magic Bento / spotlight components specifically, even in light mode — it's a signature, not a general accent.
donts: Don't use 1px solid divider lines to separate sections or list items — shift background tone or use the Ghost Border instead.
Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#ffffff) for text — use on-surface.
Don't darken a primary button on hover — brighten or scale it instead.
Don't crowd sections; if unsure whether there's enough whitespace, double the vertical padding rather than trim content.
